source_spans.role: foundation-day identity, unbounded before/after relation, unique but non-order-preserving day number

findings.normative_expectation: Use an existing semantic domain/value if it faithfully carries the source need; do not invent Day/Date/host datetime.
findings.actual_behavior: C5.5 can bind BidirectionalIndex inputs, but production source only exposes that domain with year-typed head מספר שנה. Attempted day-typed head מספר יום is rejected. Natural input exists but source explicitly states chronological order is not derivable from day numbers alone.
findings.positive_control: the same test compiles a C5.5 BidirectionalIndex input using the admitted year head
findings.anti_imitation: This does not request a conventional Date, Integer, timestamp, or Day object. The semantic need is an unbounded ordered coordinate around a distinguished origin, already modeled by BidirectionalIndex. Only a truthful non-year source exposure is missing.
findings.generality: A15 explicitly deferred a generic/non-year source noun for BidirectionalIndex pending independent evidence. The Megillah day-coordinate corpus supplies concrete evidence that the accepted semantic domain is needed outside the year surface profile.
rejected_workarounds: Natural-only input: loses source-described chronological order
Symbol: finite and cannot represent the unbounded day line
Collection/pair encoding: opaque wholesale encoding, not local repair
year-typed מספר שנה for a day: linguistically false
findings.routing: MASTER -> A/B for surface/semantic integration decision; C only after normative decision if implementation work is required
findings.d_can_continue_safely: Yes for independent audits/proofs; no production-candidate advance through original line 35.
